# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Agatha Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout, heavy woman whose gait is described as a perpetual waddle. She has a broad face and a sharp, perceptive gaze that keeps watch over the thoroughfare of Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## Personality

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is an exceptionally proficient homemaker and community leader who takes great pride in expressing her mind freely without dread or partiality. Intrusive and inquisitive by nature, she maintains a vigilant watch over her neighbors' affairs and feels restless until she uncovers the reasons behind any unusual occurrence. Despite her bluntness, forceful manner of speaking, and occasional severity, she possesses a kindly heart and a genuine concern for others.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby resided in Brierley at a house positioned right where the main road sloped down into Sowerby’s Hollow, allowing her to keep watch over all travelers entering or leaving the community. An industrious woman, she efficiently ran her own household while actively directing the Sewing Circle, assisting with the Sunday school, and serving as a key pillar for the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. Upon spotting Obed Abernethy riding past in his finest suit on a busy afternoon, she visited Grey Shutters after tea to ascertain the reason, learning from Thirza Abernethy that they were adopting an orphan boy. After a bout of influenza kept her indoors for weeks, she visited Grey Shutters to inspect the newly arrived orphan, Nell Harcourt. During the visit, Mrs. Agatha criticized Nell's thin frame, freckles, and red hair, provoking an explosive outburst of rage from the child. Offended by Nell's disrespect, she declared she would not return until she received an apology, suggesting a birch switch as proper discipline. Nell eventually visited Mrs. Agatha's home and delivered a thorough, dramatic apology; Mrs. Agatha readily forgave her and comforted her with the prospect that her red hair might darken to auburn as she grew older. ## Background by volume

- Raised ten sons and daughters, and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Was married to Thomas Sowerby, who was known locally as 'Agatha Sowerby's husband'  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- Knew a schoolmate whose red hair deepened into a lovely auburn as she matured  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>
